about: The Pivot Layout's saved form (ADR-0059: View State is serialisable): a layout read and written again, the defaults written sparingly, and a document the reader cannot read refused. Transcribed from the C# engine's LayoutJsonTests.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a layout written and read back is the same layout
ADR-0059: the defaults are written sparingly and read back as defaults
ADR-0059: a document of another version is refused, never half-read

expect.saying: A Pivot Layout of version 2 cannot be read; this reader reads version 1.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a document without a version is refused

expect.saying: A Pivot Layout names its version.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a number is read from its spelling, as an integer or not at all: {"version":1.0}

expect.saying: A Pivot Layout of version 1.0 cannot be read; this reader reads version 1.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a number is read from its spelling, as an integer or not at all: {"version":1e0}

expect.saying: A Pivot Layout of version 1e0 cannot be read; this reader reads version 1.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a number is read from its spelling, as an integer or not at all: {"version":-0}

expect.saying: A Pivot Layout of version -0 cannot be read; this reader reads version 1.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a number is read from its spelling, as an integer or not at all: {"version":12345678901234567890}

expect.saying: A Pivot Layout of version 12345678901234567890 cannot be read; this reader reads version 1.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a number is read from its spelling, as an integer or not at all: {"version":1,"version":2}

expect.saying: A Pivot Layout of version 2 cannot be read; this reader reads version 1.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a number is read from its spelling, as an integer or not at all: {"version":1,"rows":[{"field":"Region","sort":{"direction":"descending","byValue":0.0}}]}
ADR-0059: a number is read from its spelling, as an integer or not at all: {"version":1,"rows":[{"field":"Region","sort":{"direction":"descending","byValue":2147483648}}]}
ADR-0059: a number is read from its spelling, as an integer or not at all: {"version":1,"rows":[{"field":"Region","sort":{"direction":"descending","byValue":-0}}],"values":[{"field":"Amount"}]}
ADR-0059: a member the reader does not know is passed over, __proto__ among them, and an escaped letter is the letter: {"version":1,"__proto__":{"form":"tabular"},"rows":[{"field":"\u0052egion"}]}
ADR-0059: a name the reader does not know, or a shape, is refused by name: {"version":1,"form":"pivot"}

expect.saying: 'pivot' is not a form this reader knows.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a name the reader does not know, or a shape, is refused by name: {"version":1,"valuesAxis":"filters"}

expect.saying: 'filters' is not a valuesAxis this reader knows.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a name the reader does not know, or a shape, is refused by name: {"version":1,"values":[{"field":"Amount","aggregation":"median"}]}

expect.saying: 'median' is not a aggregation this reader knows.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a name the reader does not know, or a shape, is refused by name: {"version":1,"rows":[{"field":"Region","sort":{"direction":"sideways"}}]}

expect.saying: 'sideways' is not a direction this reader knows.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a name the reader does not know, or a shape, is refused by name: {"version":1,"rows":[{"field":"Region","hiddenItems":[{"kind":"colour","value":"red"}]}]}

expect.saying: 'colour' is not a kind this reader knows.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a name the reader does not know, or a shape, is refused by name: {"version":1,"rows":[{"field":"Region","hiddenItems":[{"kind":"number","value":"12,5"}]}]}

expect.saying: '12,5' is not the invariant text of a finite number.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a name the reader does not know, or a shape, is refused by name: {"version":1,"rows":[{"nofield":"Region"}]}

expect.saying: 'field' is a string, and is required.

cases.name: ADR-0059: a name the reader does not know, or a shape, is refused by name: {"version":1,"rows":{}}
ADR-0059: a name the reader does not know, or a shape, is refused by name: {"version":1,"grandTotalRow":"yes"}
ADR-0059: a name the reader does not know, or a shape, is refused by name: [1]

expect.saying: A Pivot Layout is a JSON object.
